# Load packages

```{r}

library(readr)
library(psych)

# NOTE: for the paths below to work, you must set your working directory to the root of the git repository (i.e., where this file lives) and have a data folder in this location
```

# L1 breakdown

```{r}

participants <- read_csv("data/demographics/participant_demographics.csv", col_names = TRUE)

l1_breakdown <- table(participants$l1)
# 313 L1 English, L2 French
# 149 L1 French, L2 English

l1_breakdown_by_site <- table(participants$l1, group = participants$site)
# Carleton: 187 L1 ENG, 21 L1 FR
# uOttawa: 126 L1 ENG, 128 L1 FR

```

# Age, gender, education (by site)

```{r}

# using BLP data from step 5 of cleaning (before L1_aoa was removed and L2_aoa was reverse-coded)
demog_and_language_data <- read_csv("data/questionnaires/5_unordered_removed/blp_5_unordered_removed.csv") %>%
  select(blp_L1_aoa, 
         blp_L2_aoa,
         blp_L2_proficiency_speaking, 
         blp_L2_proficiency_understanding,
         blp_L2_proficiency_reading, 
         blp_L2_proficiency_writing,
         id) %>%
  inner_join(participants, by = "id")

describe(demog_and_language_data$Age)
describeBy(demog_and_language_data$Age, demog_and_language_data$site)

table(demog_and_language_data$Gender)
table(demog_and_language_data$Gender, demog_and_language_data$site)

table(demog_and_language_data$Education)
table(demog_and_language_data$Education, demog_and_language_data$site)

```

# Language descriptives

```{r}

# L1 and L2 AoA
# no significant differences between groups in AoA measures

describe(demog_and_language_data$blp_L1_aoa)
t.test(blp_L1_aoa ~ site, data = demog_and_language_data, na.action = na.omit)

describe(demog_and_language_data$blp_L2_aoa)
t.test(blp_L2_aoa ~ site, data = demog_and_language_data, na.action = na.omit)

describeBy(demog_and_language_data$blp_L1_aoa, group = demog_and_language_data$site)
describeBy(demog_and_language_data$blp_L2_aoa, group = demog_and_language_data$site)

# L2 proficiency
# significant difference between groups on all 4 proficiency measures

describe(demog_and_language_data$blp_L2_proficiency_speaking)
describeBy(demog_and_language_data$blp_L2_proficiency_speaking, group = demog_and_language_data$site)
t.test(blp_L2_proficiency_speaking ~ site, data = demog_and_language_data, na.action = na.omit)

describe(demog_and_language_data$blp_L2_proficiency_understanding)
describeBy(demog_and_language_data$blp_L2_proficiency_understanding, group = demog_and_language_data$site)
t.test(blp_L2_proficiency_understanding ~ site, data = demog_and_language_data, na.action = na.omit)

describe(demog_and_language_data$blp_L2_proficiency_reading)
describeBy(demog_and_language_data$blp_L2_proficiency_reading, group = demog_and_language_data$site)
t.test(blp_L2_proficiency_reading ~ site, data = demog_and_language_data, na.action = na.omit)

describe(demog_and_language_data$blp_L2_proficiency_writing)
describeBy(demog_and_language_data$blp_L2_proficiency_writing, group = demog_and_language_data$site)
t.test(blp_L2_proficiency_writing ~ site, data = demog_and_language_data, na.action = na.omit)

```
